canh: men pulling down a timber house with fire hooks, London, 2 September 1666
loi_cau: The Lord Mayor, Sir Thomas Bludworth, is overwhelmed. Pepys finds him in Cannon Street, a handkerchief round his neck: "Lord, what can I do? I am spent. People will not obey me." That afternoon, the King and his brother James, Duke of York, take to the river in the royal barge, ordering houses pulled down “apace”.
mo_ta: Men pull down a timber-framed house with fire hooks to create a firebreak during the Great Fire of London in 1666, with smoke and burning buildings in the background.
